structured.answer: I decided nothing today. I'll ask you or the bank. Page after page of percentages, and I couldn't see which track is as safe as my deposits. The only things I half-recognised were "אג״ח ממשלתי" and "כספי (שקלי)", and I couldn't find out what they give or whether they're safe.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the row of filter buttons under "במה הכסף מושקע"
stuck.why: I wanted something like a deposit. I saw "אג״ח ממשלתי סחיר 1" and "אג״ח ממשלות 3". I know government bonds are safe, but I didn't know what "סחיר" means, so I didn't press either one.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the yellow strip "נתוני הרשות לא עודכנו מאז ספטמבר 2026"
stuck.why: A warning straight away. Does it mean the numbers are wrong? I wasn't sure whether to trust them.
Every company has 10 to 16 rows with the same names (מניות, כללי, עוקב מדד...). I lost my place between the name on the right and the numbers on the left. By screen 4 I was tired and stopped.
Many rows show no return at all, only this. So I can't compare them, and I didn't understand why.

used: The title "כל המסלולים בכל החברות" and the selected button "קופת גמל להשקעה 143"
Management fee column "דמי ניהול ... מהחיסכון": all of them seem to be about half a percent, 0.53% to 0.73%
Company header lines: הראל, מור, אנליסט, מיטב, אלטשולר שחם, הפניקס
skimmed: The intro paragraph under the title
The return figures for 3 and 5 years. I saw big numbers like 24.04% and 26.39% next to "מניות" and "גמיש", but those are shares, so to me it's gambling
skipped: The ring charts and the "מניות / מט״ח" percentages next to them
The "לפי חברה" tab and the top menu (השוואה למטרה, השקעה במדד...)
The "מה זה קופת גמל להשקעה" link
Screens 5 to 8, I didn't get that far
unsure_meaning: דמי ניהול מההפקדה versus מהחיסכון: is it two charges?
"פחות מ־3 שנים" in place of a return
"עוד לא דווח" with the orange circle
not_found: Any bank name, not my bank and not any other
A simple sentence saying which track is safe like a deposit
A comparison with a deposit or with the interest I get now
A place to type my amount and see what I'd pay in fees in shekels

findings.what: A huge table of numbers, dozens of rows per company. It made me anxious, and I couldn't compare the companies.
Black background with grey and coloured small text, hard to read even enlarged. Some labels are faint ("שנים", "ההפקדה").
Nothing tells you which track is low-risk or close to a deposit. The names are in professional language and English letters.
A warning that the data hasn't been updated, right at the top
Many tracks show "פחות מ־3 שנים" or "עוד לא דווח" instead of numbers
Too many filter buttons with names I don't know
Small rings in two colours that I can't tell apart
